'NativeWidthBoundary.exact_deficit' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeWidthBoundary.boundaryJets_le' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeWidthBoundary.finite_correction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'NativeWidthBoundary.finite_correction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
NativeWidthBoundary.finite_correction.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} (S : Finset ι) (multiplicity : ι → ℕ) (radius : ι → ℝ)
  (coefficient : ι → ℂ) (s width : ℝ) :
  ∑ i ∈ S, ↑(multiplicity i - NativeWidthBoundary.admitted (multiplicity i) s (radius i) width) * coefficient i =
    ∑ i ∈ S, ↑(if width < radius i then multiplicity i else 0) * coefficient i +
      ∑ i ∈ S,
        ↑(if radius i = width then multiplicity i - NativeWidthBoundary.boundaryJets (multiplicity i) s else 0) *
          coefficient i
